title: Prepare for offline waiting time
summary: Download the data you need while you still have signal, so dead zones become study time.
attribution: Original content authored for this project.

blocks.body: Study time usually shows up where the signal does not: a platform, a plane, a basement classroom. Keep a small set of reading material and your dictionary data available offline so a fifteen-minute wait is usable instead of wasted. Check this once a week on purpose, because content that only exists online is content you will not reach when you want it. Choose short things for these slots, since a passage you can finish in five minutes fits the gaps far better than a long one.
